payload.title: Time Semantics
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook, authored by Julien Emile-Geay, demonstrates how to handle and analyze time series data using Python libraries such as Pandas and Pyleoclim. The notebook focuses on loading CO2 concentration data from an Excel file, converting it into a Pandas Series, and then transforming it into a Pyleoclim Series for further analysis. It includes plotting the data and performing spectral analysis to understand the periodic components of the time series. The notebook is designed for users with basic Python knowledge and does not require prior experience with the specific libraries used.
goals: create a Pandas Series with desired time intervals
create Pyleoclim Series with desired time intervals
